## Circular to Fund Management Companies of SFC-authorised Funds

## FAQs on SFC Authorisation of Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds

1. We are pleased to inform you that we have revamped the Frequently Asked Questions About  SFC  Authorisation  of  Unit  Trusts  and  Mutual  Funds  to  better  assist  your understanding  of  the  policy  of  the  Investment  Products  Department  ('IPD')  on  the authorisation  of  unit  trusts  and  mutual  funds  under  our  Code  on  Unit  Trusts  and Mutual Funds ('UT Code') and the key post authorisation compliance issues for SFCauthorised funds.
2. We have taken this opportunity to expand the FAQs by adding common enquiries that we have received from various fund management companies.  Specifically, the new areas include flexibility in the prior notice requirement for management fee increases and matters related to our authorisation of UCITS III funds.
3. To  make  our  FAQs  more  user-friendly,  we  have  organised  the  FAQs  into  the following categories:
- FAQ on SFC Authorisation of Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds
- FAQ on Post Authorisation Compliance Issues of SFC-authorised Funds
- FAQ on SFC Authorisation of UCITS III Funds.
4. We  have  also  posted  the  FAQ  on  the  Presentation  of  Benchmark  Performance  in Advertising  Materials  of  SFC-authorised  Funds,  which  we  issued  in  March  2006 together with the relevant circular issued, on the FAQ page so that it is more readily accessible.
5. The  revamped  FAQs  can  be  found  on  the  SFC's  website  under  'Intermediaries, Licensing and Investment Products - Investment Products Related Matters - FAQs'.
6. We shall post more FAQs to enhance the transparency of our policy.  As always, we welcome you to approach us with any questions or suggestions you may have and wish to maintain open dialogue with the industry.
